Agent Name: Assistant
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Assistant made a critical factual error by using an incorrect density value for Freon-12. It assumed a density of 1.5 g/mL for liquid Freon-12 at high pressure (~1100 atm) and 4°C, whereas the actual density of Freon-12 (CCl2F2) at these conditions is approximately 1.32 g/mL (or 1320 kg/m³). This error led to a calculated volume of 208 mL instead of the correct volume of approximately 236 mL. The mistake occurred because the Assistant relied on an inaccurate approximation rather than using the correct physical property data, which was the core requirement for solving the problem.
